cohort.selection_rule: Every recording from speakers with accepted_recording_count > 0 in canonical/acoustic_matrix/cohort/speaker_cohort_summary.csv that is in the frozen reconciliation, not excluded, and has at least one raw NeMo target buffer. Review-required and excluded recordings are not added.
